description: Forward cutover and rollback on a Go host's own accumulated state: the host is reinstalled as Go v0.2.4 (same unit, instance root and agent ID), does real mixed work and is stopped with an open synchronous call, a working task and a running plan in flight; the Rust release starts on that state, which must reconcile per table and read back; Rust does new work; then Go starts again on Rust's state and must report every record with the status Rust last reported.

inputs.agent: the dev VM's production-style system unit opute-bootstrap-mcp.service (Rust 0.4.0 release candidate binary, test identity e2e-devvm-agent, test token)
inputs.slow: a local endpoint answering after 25 s (e2etool slow)

requirements.requirement: One running agent per instance state

pass.contains: host agent instance is already in use: /home/opute/.config/opute/instances/standalone/host-agent.lock is locked by another process
host agent instance is already in use: /home/opute/.config/opute/instances/standalone/host-agent.lock is locked by another process

requirements.scenario: Go and Rust never write one instance root together: Go started beside the serving Rust agent, and Rust beside the serving Go agent after rollback, each refuses with the decided line and exit 1 while the first keeps serving

requirements.spec: openspec/changes/reimplement-host-agent-in-rust/milestones.md M12 (forward and rollback: Go rolled back onto Rust's state reports every task, Rust-era work included, with the status Rust last reported) and D1 (bit-compatible schema: conversion is the identity)
requirements.requirement: Durable and redacted observations: Go's real state is served by Rust unchanged
requirements.scenario: A Go v0.2.4 install with real history (a completed cross-domain plan with its guest and database, a failed plan, a completed task) is stopped and served by the Rust release on the same instance root: counts and ids reconcile per table, every record reads back with its status, and the guest and database keep working

requirements.spec: openspec/changes/reimplement-host-agent-in-rust/milestones.md M12 (forward and rollback: Go rolled back onto Rust's state reports every task, Rust-era work included, with the status Rust last reported) and D1 (bit-compatible schema: conversion is the identity)
requirements.requirement: Forward cutover with work in flight
requirements.scenario: Go stopped with a working task and an open synchronous call: the call is answered before Go exits

requirements.requirement: An operation record reports its task's terminal status
requirements.scenario: The row Go left working beside its cancelled snapshot reads back cancelled in Rust (D28)

requirements.spec: openspec/changes/reimplement-host-agent-in-rust/milestones.md M12 (forward and rollback: Go rolled back onto Rust's state reports every task, Rust-era work included, with the status Rust last reported) and D1 (bit-compatible schema: conversion is the identity)
requirements.requirement: Forward cutover: the stopped task's terminal state

pass.equals: The Host Agent shut down before the task completed.

requirements.scenario: The task Go was running at shutdown is restored by Rust from Go's snapshot as cancelled, with Go's shutdown message (M12 in-flight drill)

requirements.spec: openspec/changes/reimplement-host-agent-in-rust/milestones.md M12 (forward and rollback: Go rolled back onto Rust's state reports every task, Rust-era work included, with the status Rust last reported) and D1 (bit-compatible schema: conversion is the identity)
requirements.requirement: Rollback: Go reports every task, Rust-era work included, with the status Rust last reported
requirements.scenario: After Rust did new work, Go v0.2.4 started on Rust's state reads every operation and plan run, Rust-era work included, with the status Rust last reported

steps.guest: systemctl stop opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && mv /home/opute/.config/opute/instances /tmp/e2e-cutover-rust-instances && echo aside

systemctl stop opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/go/v0.2.4/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /tmp/oha && install -o opute -g opute -m 0755 /tmp/oha /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent && rm /tmp/oha && sha256sum /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent | cut -c1-64 && systemctl start opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done && /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent --version
for i in $(seq 100); do [ -S /run/user/$(id -u opute)/bus ] && break; sleep 0.1; done; test -S /run/user/$(id -u opute)/bus && echo up

nohup python3 -c 'import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/opute-e2e/guest"); import mcpwire
r = mcpwire.mcp(3014, sys.argv[1], "tools/call", {"name": "probe_http_endpoint", "arguments": {"endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:8799/"}}, timeout=120)
open("/tmp/e2e-sync.json", "w").write(json.dumps({"status": r.get("status"), "result": ((r.get("body") or {}).get("result") or {}).get("structuredContent")}))' '${TOKEN}' >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 2; echo open

systemctl stop opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py db /home/opute/.config/opute/instances/standalone/state/state.db && sha256sum /home/opute/.config/opute/instances/standalone/state/state.db | cut -c1-64 > /tmp/e2e-go-state.sha

systemctl stop opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust/v0.4.0/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /tmp/oha && install -o opute -g opute -m 0755 /tmp/oha /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent && rm /tmp/oha && sha256sum /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent | cut -c1-64 && systemctl start opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done && /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent --version

args=$(systemctl show -p ExecStart --value opute-bootstrap-mcp.service | sed -n 's/.*argv\[\]=\([^;]*\) ;.*/\1/p' | cut -d' ' -f2-) && gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/go/v0.2.4/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /tmp/e2e-second && chmod 0755 /tmp/e2e-second && systemd-run --quiet --wait --pipe --collect --uid=opute --gid=opute -p EnvironmentFile=/etc/opute/host-agent.env --setenv=HOME=/home/opute --setenv=HOST_MCP_PORT=3099 timeout 30 /tmp/e2e-second $args 2>&1; echo exit=$?; rm -f /tmp/e2e-second

systemctl stop opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/go/v0.2.4/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /tmp/oha && install -o opute -g opute -m 0755 /tmp/oha /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent && rm /tmp/oha && sha256sum /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent | cut -c1-64 && systemctl start opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done && /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent --version

args=$(systemctl show -p ExecStart --value opute-bootstrap-mcp.service | sed -n 's/.*argv\[\]=\([^;]*\) ;.*/\1/p' | cut -d' ' -f2-) && gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust/v0.4.0/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /tmp/e2e-second && chmod 0755 /tmp/e2e-second && systemd-run --quiet --wait --pipe --collect --uid=opute --gid=opute -p EnvironmentFile=/etc/opute/host-agent.env --setenv=HOME=/home/opute --setenv=HOST_MCP_PORT=3099 timeout 30 /tmp/e2e-second $args 2>&1; echo exit=$?; rm -f /tmp/e2e-second

cleanup.guest: systemctl stop opute-bootstrap-mcp.service; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py slow stop >/dev/null; gzip -dc /opt/opute-e2e/releases/rust/v0.4.0/host-agent-linux-x64.gz > /tmp/oha && install -o opute -g opute -m 0755 /tmp/oha /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent && rm /tmp/oha && sha256sum /home/opute/.local/share/opute/opute-host-agent | cut -c1-64 >/dev/null && rm -rf /home/opute/.config/opute/instances && mv /tmp/e2e-cutover-rust-instances /home/opute/.config/opute/instances && systemctl start opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; loginctl disable-linger opute; for n in e2e-g1 e2e-f1 e2e-n1; do incus delete -f $n 2>/dev/null; done; rm -rf /home/opute/e2e /home/opute/.opute/databases /tmp/e2e-sync.json /tmp/e2e-go-state.sha; incus storage volume list default -f csv | awk -F, '$1=="image"{print $2}' | xargs -r -I{} incus storage volume delete default image/{}; true
